method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: ‘Outlier’ S&P 500 Earnings Strength Cheers Wall Street’s Bulls
Equities.reason: Frames a market regime dominated by stronger-than-expected S&P 500 earnings; directly supports a bullish, earnings-led equity narrative (high relevance because it signals broad market impulse rather than single-stock noise).

Equities.title: S&P 500 earnings growth 'once-in-a-generation,' says Elizabeth Evans
Equities.reason: Echoes the bullish earnings narrative for the S&P 500; adds incremental confirmation of market leadership from earnings (treated as supportive but lower relevance due to format/source and overlap with other earnings stories).

Equities.reason: Directly links AI capex to improving corporate earnings — supports the pro-risk, tech-led equity rally; relevance elevated because it connects investment trends to realized earnings.

Equities.reason: Illustrates balance-sheet strength and strategic investments by a marquee AI leader — supportive for tech/AI sentiment but company-specific, so medium relevance.

Equities.summary: The jump in revenue underscores the rapid growth of the Claude chatbot maker as it prepares for a potential blockbuster initial public offering.
Equities.reason: Stronger-than-expected revenue at a major AI company underpins the AI-led growth narrative and potential IPO activity — positive for tech equities with moderate relevance.

Equities.title: Technology Stocks Lift Equities as Treasuries Rise: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Combines tech leadership with bond-market moves (Treasuries rising/lower yields) — supportive cross-market signal for equities; relevance elevated because it captures policy/liquidity transmission to stocks.

Equities.title: U.S. stock futures little changed as investors ponder the Fed’s next move
Equities.reason: Reflects investor caution tied to Fed policy uncertainty — modestly negative for near-term equities given potential volatility and policy risk.

Equities.title: Federal Reserve: Changing communications and higher volatility – TD Securities
Equities.summary: TD Securities’ James Rossiter argues that the Federal Reserve is leading a structural shift away from detailed forward guidance and explicit reaction functions, forcing markets to infer policy from incoming data.
Equities.reason: A structural shift away from explicit Fed guidance raises volatility and makes policy harder to price — negative for equities' risk appetite and positioning (higher relevance because it affects market regime).

Equities.title: China's economy slows further in July as retail sales barely grow, investment slump steepens
Equities.summary: The data is reinforcing concerns about the health of the world's second-largest economy, which has grappled with a deepening supply-demand imbalance.
Equities.reason: Slowing China demand increases downside risk for global cyclicals and EM-linked equities — material negative for global equity growth expectations (high relevance).

Equities.title: Japan second-quarter GDP grows 1.1% on an annualized basis, missing expectations
Equities.summary: On an annualized basis, Japan saw growth of 1.1%, against estimates of 2%.
Equities.reason: A downside GDP surprise in Japan weakens regional growth outlook and could weigh on Asian equity sentiment — modest negative for global equities.

Equities.title: Stock-Market Calm Masks Fast Shifting Investor Sentiment
Equities.reason: Signals latent fragility and rapid sentiment shifts despite calm prices — a negative for complacent positioning and implies higher hedging demand (medium relevance).

Equities.title: Emerging markets march out of 'valley of tears' as investors diversify
Equities.reason: Describes renewed flows into EM equities as investors diversify — positive for regional equity allocations, but relevance limited to EM flow dynamics rather than global regime change.

Equities.title: Berkshire adds $17 billion to Alphabet stake

Equities.reason: High-profile institutional buying of a major tech name supports the big-tech/AI leadership narrative and signals confidence from a marquee investor (moderate relevance as it's a single-investor action with broader signaling value).

Rates.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ hike expectations support JPY against US Dollar – MUFG
Rates.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny and Lee Hardman report that Japanese government bond yields are rising despite weaker-than-expected GDP, as markets focus on prospects for further Bank of Japan rate hikes.
Rates.reason: Rising JGB yields on BOJ-hike bets imply bond selloff (yields up = negative for rates). MUFG note is a direct market-observed move in sovereign yields; moderate relevance as a regional but market-significant driver.

Rates.title: Japan’s Bond Yields Climb on BOJ Hike Bets, Fiscal Concerns
Rates.reason: Headline reports of rising JGB yields driven by BOJ hike expectations and fiscal worries are a clear negative for bond prices; high relevance given Japan’s large sovereign market and potential spillovers to global rates.

Rates.title: AI-driven surge in bond yields could be next risk for markets and growth
Rates.reason: Reuters flags a thematic risk of higher yields from AI-driven dynamics — a broad macro narrative pushing yields up (negative for bonds) with material market-growth implications, hence high relevance.

Rates.title: Bonds Face a Bigger Threat Than the Fed as Global Rates Climb
Rates.reason: Broad Bloomberg piece highlighting global rate increases — translates into sustained bond pressure (yields up = negative). High relevance because it frames a cross-market, multi-jurisdictional risk to bonds beyond central-bank policy.

Rates.title: US 20-Year Bond Sale to Test Demand as Yield Curve Steepens
Rates.reason: Primary issuance and steepening curve imply pressure on long-end Treasuries (yields higher = negative). Relevant to supply/demand and term-premium dynamics but more technical than thematic, so moderate relevance.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Softer data challenges resilience – MUFG
Rates.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny and Lee Hardman note that weaker United States (US) data and lower short-term Treasury yields are undermining US Dollar (USD) support, even as the US Dollar Index (DXY) holds above its 200-day moving average near 99.200.
Rates.reason: Explicit link to lower short-term Treasury yields (yields down = positive for bond prices). Moderate relevance: reflects near-term data-driven repricing that supports bonds.

Rates.title: Treasury Yields Edge Lower But Stay Elevated
Rates.reason: Local move: yields slightly lower (small positive for bonds) but still elevated — modest relevance as a near-term nuance rather than a regime shift.
